eps.o: Celebrated Colombian superstar Carlos Vives, an 18-time Latin Grammy and multiple Grammy Award winner, performs with his 11-piece band La Provincia, showcasing songs from El Último Disco alongside a career-spanning collection of beloved hits.

eps.t: ACL Hall of Fame Honors Brandi Carlile
eps.o: Austin City Limits inducts 11-time Grammy Award winner Brandi Carlile into the 12th Annual ACL Hall of Fame. Bonnie Raitt performs in tribute and inducts Carlile and the honoree takes the stage with favorites and songs from Returning to Myself.

Three-time Grammy Award-winning bluegrass superstar Billy Strings delivers an electrifying ACL return with highlights from his Grammy-winning album 'Highway Prayers' and acclaimed release 'So Much for Goodbyes,' alongside timeless bluegrass classics.
Grammy-winning R&B trailblazer Miguel lights up the ACL stage in a dynamic performance featuring songs from his acclaimed album 'CAOS' alongside fan favorites from across his celebrated career.

Breakout British singer-songwriter Sienna Spiro, one of music’s most compelling new artists, brings her showstopping vocals and emotionally rich songwriting to a spellbinding ACL debut. She performs highlights from her acclaimed debut album 'Visitor.'

Three-time Grammy Award winner Olivia Rodrigo returns to the ACL stage with her fearless songwriting and arena-sized performances. The global pop superstar performs highlights from her chart-topping album 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love.'

Grammy-nominated R&B singer-songwriter Ari Lennox brings her soulful vocals, effortless groove and magnetic presence to ACL. She performs highlights from her acclaimed album Vacancy alongside fan favorites “Soft Girl Era” and “Shea Butter Baby.”

Reigning CMA Awards Vocal Group of the Year and ACM Awards Group of the Year, Alabama country-rock group The Red Clay Strays bring their electrifying live show to the ACL stage. They perform highlights from their acclaimed album 'Grateful.'

Country star Ty Myers makes his ACL debut, showcasing his soulful Texas sound and dynamic guitar skills. The 19-year-old singer-songwriter performs highlights from his acclaimed album 'Heavy On The Soul,' inspired by Southern rock, soul and blues.

Colombian-American singer-songwriter Sebastián Yatra, a global ambassador of modern Latin pop, lights up the ACL stage. The multiple Latin Grammy Award winner and Grammy nominee performs fan favorites and highlights from his acclaimed album 'Milagro.'
